project.description: The name of the project to add ngx-formbar to.

registrationStyle.description: How components and validators will be registered

provideInline.description: Configure provideFormbar in the root providers, without a provider configuration file (defaults to false)

providerConfigPath.description: Folder for the provider configuration file. Defaults to 'app'

providerConfigFileName.description: Name of the provider configuration file. Defaults to 'formbar.config.ts'

includeSyncValidators.description: Whether to include the setup for validators

includeAsyncValidators.description: Whether to include the setup for async validators

useHelper.description: Include helper files for view providers

helperPath.description: Folder for the helper files. Defaults to 'app/shared/helper'

splitRegistrations.description: Whether to split the registrations into a separate file

registrationsPath.description: Folder for the registration files. Defaults to 'app/registrations'

useSchematicConfig.description: Create a schematics configuration file. If false, registration and helper settings go in angular.json, no content union is created, and the schema generator has to be set up by hand

schematicsConfigPath.description: Folder for the schematics configuration file. Defaults to 'app'

schematicConfigFileName.description: Name of the schematics configuration file. Defaults to 'formbar-schematic.config.json'

installSchematics.description: Whether to install @ngx-formbar/schematics (generators for control, group, block, array, register, schema)
installSchematics.x-prompt: Would you like to install @ngx-formbar/schematics for component generators (control, group, block, array, register, schema)?
